name: architect
description: Deterministically gates Claude Code plan mode against Architect (an architecture-decision copilot): before a plan can be proposed, it is submitted, checked against recorded decisions, and any unwaived violation blocks ExitPlanMode until resolved or explicitly waived. Optional enforce-approvals mode additionally requires a human reviewer to approve the plan before ExitPlanMode is allowed through. Optionally (off by default, double opt-in) shares the names of files you have changed locally so reviewers can see overlap with teammates' in-flight work.
